{{Quote|I'm sorry it took this long to reach you, but these are ''dark times''! Felacat is one of a ''thousand'' warring planets!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Miaria Prrt]]|<ref name="The Feral Queen" />}}
The '''Felacat system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felacat]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Felacatian]]s.<ref name="Bad Business" />
